Heading.ChatBreaksRules.V2: Your text chat breaks the rules
Description.ChatBreaksRulesWarning: Your text chat use may be suspended if you break the rules again.
Description.ChatSuspendedMultipleDays: You can't use chat for {{duration}} days because one or more of your messages broke the rules. If you keep breaking the rules, you could be banned.
Description.ChatSuspendedSingleDay: You can't use chat for 1 day because one or more of your messages broke the rules. If you keep breaking the rules, you could be banned.
Description.ChatSuspendedSingleHour: You can't use chat for 1 hour because one or more of your messages broke the rules.
Description.ChatSuspendedMultipleMinutes: You can't use chat for {{duration}} minutes because one or more of your messages broke the rules.
